title: Oven-Ready Slovakian Bread Burger
description: A yeasty, bouncy Slovakian bread burger with spicy red pepper paste and a delicate layer of bonito flakes, baked to perfection on a binchotan grill.

ingredients.name: bonito flakes
ingredients.notes: use vegetarian bonito flakes if following satvik

instructions: In a bowl combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt, stirring until evenly mixed.
Add warm water and olive oil to the dry mixture, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise for 60 minutes until doubled in size.
While the dough rests, mix grated tofu, red pepper paste, soy sauce, basil, and oregano until well combined.
Divide the dough into four equal portions and shape each into a loaf shape.
Place the loaves on a parchment-lined pan and let them proof for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and bake the loaves for 12 minutes until golden.
Slice the loaves horizontally and top each with the tofu mixture, then sprinkle bonito flakes on top.
Return the assembled burgers to the oven for 6 minutes to meld flavors and toast the topping.
